args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring claimed banker's rounding but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly failure in tests/test_money.py.
Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so ties round to the nearest even cent
(2.675 -> 2.68, 2.665 -> 2.66).

args.body:
## Summary
Fixes the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`: `round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite being documented (and required per FIN-212) to use banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: switch rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so half-cent ties round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.675 → 2.68`, `2.665 → 2.66`).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.
